description: This file defines the JpGraph class within the PhpSpreadsheet Chart Renderer namespace, responsible for initializing external JpGraph modules when needed.

classes.name: JpGraph
classes.description: A class responsible for loading and initializing the JpGraph modules for chart rendering within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the JpGraph modules if they have not been loaded already. Loads various chart modules such as bar, contour, line, pie, etc.
